name: LMEB
description: Memory embeddings are crucial for memory-augmented systems, such as OpenClaw, but their evaluation is underexplored in current text embedding benchmarks, which narrowly focus on traditional passage retrieval and fail to assess models' ability to handle long-horizon memory retrieval tasks involving fragmented, context-dependent, and temporally distant information. To address this gap, we introduce the Long-horizon Memory Embedding Benchmark (LMEB), a comprehensive framework for evaluating embedding models on complex, long-horizon memory retrieval.
